available.quote: the Board may issue a license by reciprocity to practice architecture in the State to an individual who: (1) is licensed to practice architecture in another state or country; or (2) is certified by the Council under subsection (c) of this section.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state or country (or certified by NCARB), be of good character and reputation, pay application and license fees, and provide evidence that they met requirements at least equivalent to Maryland's at the time of original licensure, or currently meet Maryland's requirements.
requirements.quote: the Board may issue a license by reciprocity under this section for an applicant who is licensed to practice architecture in another state or country only if the applicant: (1) is of good character and reputation; (2) pays to the Board: (i) a nonrefundable application fee set by the Board; and (ii) a license fee set by the Board; and (3) provides adequate evidence that: (i) the applicant became licensed in the other state or country after meeting, in that or any other state or country, requirements that were at least equivalent to those then required by the laws of this State; or (ii) at the time of application for a license by reciprocity under this section, the applicant meets the requirements currently required by the laws of this State.

title_protection.quote: Unless authorized under this title to practice architecture, a person may not represent to the public, by use of a title, including "architect", "licensed architect", or "registered architect", by description of services, methods, or procedures, or otherwise, that the person is authorized to practice architecture in the State.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has had a license to practice architecture in another state revoked or suspended for grounds that would justify revocation or suspension of a license under this title, except for failure to pay a license fee.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: a corporation, limited liability company, or partnership shall hold a permit issued by the Board before the corporation, limited liability company, or partnership may operate a business through which architecture is practiced.

definition_quote.value: "Practice architecture" means to provide any service or creative work: (i) in regard to an addition to, alteration of, or construction of a building or an integral part of a building; and (ii) that requires education, training, and experience in architecture.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice architecture" means to provide any service or creative work: (i) in regard to an addition to, alteration of, or construction of a building or an integral part of a building; and (ii) that requires education, training, and experience in architecture.

value: architectural design and preparation of related documents
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice architecture" includes: (i) architectural design and preparation of related documents; (ii) consultation; (iii) design coordination; (iv) evaluation; (v) investigation; and (vi) planning.

interior_designer_certification_availabl.quote: a certified interior designer or other individual to provide interior design services as that term is defined in Title 8 of this article

interior_design_services_defined.quote: a certified interior designer or other individual to provide interior design services as that term is defined in Title 8 of this article

permitted_firm_structures.quote: a licensed architect may practice architecture for others through: (i) a corporation as an officer, director, employee, or agent of the corporation; (ii) a limited liability company as a member, employee, or agent of the limited liability company; or (iii) a partnership as a partner, employee, or agent of the partnership.

firm_design_professional_ownership_minim.quote: At least two-thirds of the directors of a corporation shall be licensed in this or another state to practice architecture, engineering, or landscape architecture.

seal_required.quote: Before a licensed architect issues to a client or submits to a public authority any final drawing, plan, specification, report, or other document required for the issuance of a building permit, the licensed architect who prepared or approved the document shall sign, seal, and date the document.

exempt_building_types.quote: This title does not limit the right of: (1) a construction contractor to administer construction contracts; (2) a developer, builder, or contractor to provide design services related to the developer's, builder's, or contractor's own construction of new or existing single-family or two-family dwellings, or structures ancillary to them, or farm buildings; (3) a certified interior designer or other individual to provide interior design services as that term is defined in Title 8 of this article; or (4) an individual to prepare plans, drawings, and other documents in connection with the addition, alteration, construction, design, or repair of a single-family dwelling and appurtenances that are for the personal use of that individual or a member of the immediate family of that individual.

ncarb_certificate_reciprocity_prima_faci.quote: the Board may issue a license by reciprocity under this section for an applicant who is certified by the Council only if: (1) the applicant: (i) is of good character and reputation; and (ii) pays to the Board: 1. a nonrefundable application fee set by the Board; and 2. a license fee set by the Board; and (2) the Board receives from the Council a certified copy of its certificate for the applicant that certifies that the applicant is licensed to practice architecture in another state or country.

ncarb_standards_adoptable.quote: The Board may adopt an examination or a recommended grading procedure of the Council or any similar organization.

unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.value: Misdemeanor; fine not exceeding $3,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 1 year or both
unauthorized_practice_criminal_penalty_f.quote: A person who violates § 3-601, § 3-602, § 3-603, or § 3-604 of this subtitle is guilty of a misdemeanor and on conviction is subject to a fine not exceeding $3,000 or imprisonment not exceeding 1 year or both.

civil_penalty_maximum.quote: the Board may impose on a person who violates § 3-601, § 3-602, § 3-603, or § 3-604 of this subtitle a penalty not exceeding $5,000 for each violation.
